deck_title: Jacobi-Liouville trace-free isochoric squash-and-stretch vs naive uniaxial volume bloat rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Joseph Liouville (1838) & Carl Gustav Jacob Jacobi (1845) trace-determinant isochoric squash-and-stretch law (det(exp(A)) = exp(tr(A)) = 1.0000 when logarithmic strain trace ln(lambda_x) + ln(lambda_y) + ln(lambda_z) = 0, contracting lateral axes by lambda_x = lambda_z = 1 / sqrt(1 + u) across 17 axial stretch stations lambda_y = 1 + u in [1.0000, 2.0000] to lock 3D volume Jacobian J = 1.0000x with 0/17 bloated stations) versus naive uncompensated uniaxial stretch (lambda_x = lambda_z = 1.0, which inflates 3D volume Jacobian as J = 1 + u to 1.2500x at u=0.25, 1.5000x at u=0.50, and 2.0000x / +100% balloon bloat at u=1.00 across 16/17 stations) and 64-substep sl(3) Lie exponential integration.
